runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to the change under test)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <fresh scratch dir>
evidence_tree.note: The scenario definition itself is not in the data/ export (grep for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' over the whole export returns nothing), so the computation below is a structural identification of the multiplier from the cached wiki text, not a re-run of the scenario.

observed_delta.rounding_envelope: with values rounded to 1 dp, the true ratio lies in [149.65/138.649, 149.75/138.55] = [1.07935, 1.08084]; the only round constant in that envelope is exactly 1.08

independent_computation.identification: The change is a pure multiplicative x1.08 damage amplifier newly applied to this event. 138.6 x 1.08 = 149.688, which rounds to 149.7 at the corpus's 1-decimal precision. This is the melee branch of Bloodsong's Expose Weakness (8%).
independent_computation.step_1_source_of_the_8_percent: data/items.json id 3877 (Bloodsong), passives[0] 'Spellblade', branches[0]: '... If the target is a champion, inflict them with Expose Weakness for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).'
independent_computation.step_2_rd_template_ordering: The {{rd|A|B}} template is melee-first / ranged-second. Cross-checked inside the same cached file against effects whose melee/ranged split is unambiguous: Ravenous Hydra / Tiamat / Stridebreaker Cleave '{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}', Titanic Hydra Cleave '{{rd|1%|{{fd|0.5}}%}}', Death's Dance Ignore Pain '{{rd|30%|10%}}', Sundered Sky heal '{{rd|100%|50%}} base AD'. In every case the first argument is the melee value. Therefore Expose Weakness = 8% melee, 5% ranged.
independent_computation.step_3_independent_extraction_check: data/atoms/items.json entry '3877' -> atom_id 'damage.bonus', evidence 'passive:Spellblade@kw:increased damage', values [10.0, 100.0, 4.0, 8.0, 5.0, 1.5] with units [s, percent, s, percent, percent, flat] — i.e. 10 s spellblade window, 100% base AD, 4 s Expose Weakness duration, 8% (melee) / 5% (ranged) amp, 1.5 s cooldown. The same 8.0/5.0 pair is reproduced by an extraction pipeline independent of my reading of the branch text.
independent_computation.step_4_arithmetic: damage_new = damage_old x (1 + 0.08) = 138.6 x 1.08 = 149.688 -> 149.7 (1 dp). The ranged branch would give 138.6 x 1.05 = 145.53 -> 145.5, which is not the observed new value; the observed new value therefore encodes the melee 8% branch exactly.
independent_computation.step_5_composition_check: 'increased damage from all sources' is a standalone multiplicative amplifier on the damage instance. Because the observed ratio is exactly 1.08 (not 1.18/1.10, 1.13/1.05, etc.), the engine multiplied a previously-unamplified instance by 1.08 rather than folding 8% into a shared additive amp bucket — the correct composition for this effect.

alternatives_ruled_out.hypothesis: Black Cleaver 'Carve' armor reduction re-tuning (e.g. the 0.8*max_stacks constant replaced by the exact Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) recommended in docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.3)
alternatives_ruled_out.ruled_out_because: data/items.json 3071 gives Carve = 6% armor reduction per stack, 5 stacks, 30% max. Moving from the 0.8*5 = 4-stack constant (24% reduction) to the full 5-stack cap (30% reduction) changes post-mitigation damage by a factor (100 + 0.76A)/(100 + 0.70A). Solving that = 1.08 requires target armor A = 2000, which is not a reachable armor value. Carve alone cannot produce an 8% swing at any realistic armor, so the leaf's change is not a Cleaver-model change.

alternatives_ruled_out.hypothesis: The delta is Bloodsong's Spellblade bonus damage (100% base AD) being added to this event
alternatives_ruled_out.ruled_out_because: The additive delta is only 11.1. A level-appropriate base AD post-mitigation is several times that, and the delta is exactly 8.009% of the old value (a ratio, not a constant addend).

alternatives_ruled_out.hypothesis: Old value already carried a 5% (ranged) Expose Weakness and the fix raised it to 8% (melee)
alternatives_ruled_out.ruled_out_because: That would be a x(1.08/1.05) = x1.02857 change: 138.6 x 1.02857 = 142.56 -> 142.6, not 149.7. The old value carried no Expose Weakness amplification on this event at all.

alternatives_ruled_out.hypothesis: Riftmaker 'Void Corruption' (also exactly 8% increased damage at 4 stacks)
alternatives_ruled_out.ruled_out_because: Riftmaker is not named in the scenario id; Black Cleaver and Bloodsong are. Both items are target-debuff amplifiers (Carve armor reduction, Expose Weakness damage amp), which is a coherent thing for a coupled roster scenario to pin.

why_not_old_value_correct: For 138.6 to be right, Expose Weakness would have to not apply to this event. The wiki branch is explicit that the debuff makes the target 'take increased damage from all sources' for 4 seconds after the Spellblade-empowered attack lands on a champion. A champion-damage event inside that 4 s window must be amplified. That only some leaves in the scenario moved (this is leaf 46 of a set) is consistent with the 4 s window and 1.5 s cooldown being modelled as gates rather than the amp being applied blanketly.

residual_uncertainty.detail: Expose Weakness's magnitude keys off whether the Bloodsong HOLDER is melee (8%) or ranged (5%). The scenario roster is not present in the data/ export, so I could not read who holds Bloodsong. The observed value encodes the melee branch.
residual_uncertainty.assessment: Judged low risk: (a) the scenario id pairs Bloodsong with Black Cleaver, a melee-bruiser item (40 AD / 400 HP / 20 AH, Carve triggers on physical damage), so a melee holder is the natural reading; (b) the resulting value is exact to the rounding, i.e. the implementation read a real sourced constant rather than an invented one. If the Bloodsong holder in this scenario is in fact a ranged champion, the correct value would be 138.6 x 1.05 = 145.5 and the verdict would flip to 'both_wrong'. Recommend the reviewer confirm the holder's attack range against the scenario fixture.

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

Ravenous Hydra/Tiamat/Stridebreaker Cleave: '{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}'; Titanic Hydra Cleave: '{{rd|1%|{{fd|0.5}}%}}'; Death's Dance Ignore Pain: 'Reduces {{rd|30%|10%}} of all post-mitigation ... damage'; Sundered Sky: 'heal you for {{as|{{rd|100%|50%}} '''base''' AD}}'
